items.title: Data table
items.description: Sortable, filterable, paginated table with row selection - declared, not hand-wired.

items.title: Calendar
items.description: Themeable month / year / decade calendar with every selection mode.

items.title: Time picker
items.description: Analog clock-dial time picker (12/24-hour, minute snapping).

items.title: Date-time picker
items.description: Masked text field with DATE / TIME dropdown tabs.

items.title: Date-range input
items.description: Compact start-to-end range field with preset shortcuts.

items.title: Button
items.description: Themeable press primitive with variants, sizes, loading state, icon slot, and auto anchor rendering.

items.title: Button group
items.description: Segmented button bar - single-select switcher, multi-select toggle set, or plain action row.

items.title: Repeat button
items.description: A button that keeps firing while held - after an initial delay, then at a steady interval.

items.title: Toggle button
items.description: A button with a sticky pressed on/off state, exposed via aria-pressed.

items.title: Switch button
items.description: An on/off sliding switch with the ARIA switch role for settings that apply immediately.

items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A themed checkbox with a true indeterminate state and an optional inline label.

items.title: Radio group
items.description: Accessible single-select radio group with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation.

items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating control on the ARIA slider pattern with hover preview, keyboard, and half steps.

items.title: Text input
items.description: Single-line text field for text, email, url, tel and search, with clear button and validation chrome.

items.title: Text area
items.description: Multi-line text field with optional auto-grow and a character counter.

items.title: Number input
items.description: Numeric field with min/max/step, spinner buttons, thousands grouping, precision and prefix/suffix.

items.title: Password input
items.description: Password field with a reveal toggle and an optional 4-level strength meter.

items.title: Masked input
items.description: Pattern-masked text input that formats as you type and reports masked and raw values.

items.title: Phone input
items.description: Country dial-code selector plus a national number field that emits an E.164-style string.

items.title: Color input
items.description: Color swatch that opens a popover with a hex field, native picker and preset palette.

items.title: OTP input
items.description: Segmented one-time-code / PIN entry with auto-advance and paste distribution.

items.title: Duration input
items.description: Duration editor whose value is minutes but which accepts 1h 30m, 1:30 or 90.

items.title: Tags input
items.description: Editable token / chips input over a string array with de-dupe and a max cap.

items.title: List box
items.description: Inline single/multi-select list, a WAI-ARIA listbox with type-ahead and optional windowing.

items.title: Drop-down list
items.description: Single-select dropdown with a portalled, auto-flipping option list and no typing.

items.title: Combo box
items.description: Searchable single-select where the value must come from the list; local or remote filtering.

items.title: Auto complete
items.description: Free-text input with a live-filtered suggestion list; any value allowed.

items.title: Multi select
items.description: Multi-select dropdown with a chip trigger, search box, and remote options.

items.title: Tree select
items.description: Single-select dropdown over an indented, collapsible tree (cascader pattern).

items.title: Grid select
items.description: Grid-in-a-dropdown single-select that picks a row across multiple columns.

items.title: Country input
items.description: Searchable country picker with flag, dial code, and ISO alpha-2 output.

items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or dual-thumb range slider with steps, ticks, scale labels, and keyboard control.

items.title: Gauge
items.description: Radial arc gauge for a single KPI with optional colored threshold bands.

items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear determinate or indeterminate progress bar with intents, sizes, and label.

items.title: Circular progress
items.description: Ring progress indicator, determinate or spinning, with center label or content.

items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Tiny inline line, area, bar, or win/loss chart from a plain number array.

items.title: Stat
items.description: KPI metric card with a big value and auto-colored up/down delta trend.

items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, portalled to escape overflow-hidden ancestors.

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small hover and focus tooltip anchored to its child, wired via aria-describedby.

items.title: Modal
items.description: An accessible modal dialog with backdrop, focus trap, and Escape/backdrop close.

items.title: Drawer
items.description: An edge-anchored side sheet (right/left/top/bottom) with the full dialog a11y contract.

items.title: Toaster
items.description: The host that renders the shared toast queue; call toast() from anywhere.

items.title: Context menu
items.description: Wraps a region and opens a menu at the pointer on right-click or long-press.

items.title: Menu
items.description: A trigger-opened dropdown menu with submenus, icons, shortcuts, and keyboard support.

items.title: Hover card
items.description: A rich preview card that opens on hover, positioned by the shared engine.

items.title: Popconfirm
items.description: A quick confirm step in a popover for low-stakes destructive actions.

items.title: Menubar
items.description: An app-style row of dropdown menus with roving focus and full keyboard support.

items.title: Tabs
items.description: WAI-ARIA tab strip with roving arrow-key navigation, four positions, and optional closable tabs.

items.title: Accordion
items.description: WAI-ARIA accordion of collapsible sections with single- or multiple-expand and roving header focus.

items.title: Splitter
items.description: Two resizable panes split by a draggable WAI-ARIA separator, with pointer drag and arrow-key resize.

items.title: Dock layout
items.description: Basic docking layout with nested resizable split groups, tabbed leaves, and drag-to-dock.

items.title: Dock manager
items.description: Full docking manager with floating windows, tab reordering, and pinning / auto-hide.

items.title: Card
items.description: Themed surface container with an optional header, body, and footer.

items.title: Divider
items.description: Theme-driven separator line, horizontal or vertical, solid or dashed, with an optional label.

items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scroll container with the kit's themed custom scrollbars and contained overscroll.

items.title: Grid chart
items.description: Inline-SVG chart that renders a ChartSpec with no external charting dependency, bound to grid data.

items.title: Form
items.description: Schema-driven form that renders the UI-kit controls from a FormField[] with validation and submit.

items.title: Field
items.description: Shared label / hint / error chrome that makes any control behave consistently.

items.title: File upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file field with click-to-browse, accept / size / count validation, and a file list.

items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Single animated show/hide section with accessible trigger and inert closed region.

items.title: Layout primitives
items.description: SvStack (column), SvGroup (row), and SvSimpleGrid (responsive grid) - gap-based flex/grid wrappers.

items.title: Typography
items.description: Prose primitives - SvTitle, SvText, SvAnchor, SvBlockquote, SvMark, SvList - on one type scale.

items.title: Display primitives
items.description: Small display helpers - SvKbd, SvCode, SvAspectRatio, SvVisuallyHidden.

items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status pill or count label tinted from the grid's semantic tokens.

items.title: Segmented
items.description: Compact single-select track for view switchers and small enum settings, on the radio-group core.

items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading ring that inherits text colour and respects reduced-motion.

items.title: Loading overlay
items.description: Cover-a-container scrim with a centred spinner while content loads or saves.

items.title: Result
items.description: Full result page (success / error / warning / info / not-found) with icon, title, and actions.

items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering loading placeholder that reserves layout space while data loads.

items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline contextual message with icon, title, dismiss, and trailing actions.

items.title: Empty state
items.description: Centered placeholder for empty lists and no-results screens with an action slot.

items.title: Chip
items.description: Compact interactive pill for tags, filter tokens, and entities with remove.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical activity or history feed with a connecting rail and colored markers.

items.title: Avatar
items.description: User avatar with automatic initials-and-color fallback and presence status dot.

items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Overlapping stacked avatars with a +N overflow pill for members and assignees.

items.title: Carousel
items.description: Sliding slideshow with arrows, dots, autoplay that pauses on hover, and swipe.

items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation trail that shows where the current page sits in your app's hierarchy.

items.title: Pagination
items.description: A standalone pager: page numbers with ellipsis, prev/next, and optional first/last.

items.title: Stepper
items.description: A progress stepper for wizards and multi-step forms, horizontal or vertical.

items.title: Nav pane
items.description: An Outlook-style app-shell sidebar with collapsible sections, badges, and modules.

items.title: Tree
items.description: A WAI-ARIA tree view with expand/select, tri-state checkboxes, virtualization, and lazy load.

items.title: Command
items.description: A Cmd+K command palette: fuzzy-searchable actions in a focus-trapped dialog.

items.title: Tour
items.description: A guided product tour that spotlights targets and walks users through each step.

items.title: Rich text
items.description: A lightweight WYSIWYG editor with a formatting toolbar that emits HTML.

items.title: Login
items.description: A two-column authentication page: a branded gradient panel beside a sign-in SvCard with social SvButtons, SvTextInput + SvPasswordInput (reveal), remember-me SvCheckBox, an "or" SvDivider and forgot-password link. Drops into any route as-is.

items.title: Sign-up
items.description: A centered account-creation card: two-up name fields, work email, a password with the live strength meter, a plan SvSegmented switch, terms SvCheckBox and a benefits rail. Submit fires a promise toast. Pure UI-kit.

items.title: Two-factor / OTP
items.description: The verification step of a sign-in flow: SvOtpInput (6 digits, auto-advance + onComplete), a resend cooldown timer, and the waiting -> verifying -> verified states. Enter 000000 to see the error path.

items.title: Sign-in with providers
items.description: SSO-first SvCard with Google, GitHub and Microsoft SvButtons, plus a SAML option that reveals a company-domain SvTextInput. Below an SvDivider, a magic-link form switches to a Check your inbox state with a 30 s resend cooldown.

items.title: Forgot password
items.description: Password recovery in one SvCard. An email SvTextInput with validation and a loading SvButton leads to a check-your-email state that names the address, has a 60 s resend cooldown and a back-to-sign-in link.

items.title: 404 with helpful links
items.description: Site search SvTextInput with a leading icon that filters a list of popular pages as you type (icon, title, description, chevron). An empty search shows a field error; a real query fires a toast.

items.title: 500 server error
items.description: Retry SvButton with loading that alternates fail and succeed, each with a toast. Also shows a request id with a Copy button, the failure time and a status link; SvBadge flips to Resolved.

items.title: Maintenance page
items.description: Planned downtime page with a live countdown, an SvProgress bar and step list that advance with the clock, and a notify-me SvTextInput that validates the email before it submits.

items.title: Access denied
items.description: 403 page naming the missing permission, with the signed-in account (SvAvatar and email) and Switch account. Request access opens an optional SvTextArea note, sends with loading and a toast, then shows Pending.

items.title: Empty state
items.description: An empty Dashboards page: SvEmptyState with an icon, title, one sentence and a New dashboard SvButton that opens an inline SvTextInput form. Creating adds the dashboard to the list; deleting the last one brings the empty state back, with Undo in the toast.

items.title: Upload drop zone
items.description: A Files area that starts as a large dashed SvFileUpload drop zone (PDF, Word, Excel, images, 10 MB each). Added files list with an SvProgress upload bar, size and a Remove button; removing every file returns the empty state.

items.title: No search results
items.description: A customer search with an SvTextInput and removable SvChip filters whose starting query matches nothing. SvEmptyState echoes the query and offers Clear filters, Clear search or removing one filter; clearing brings results back.

items.title: Empty widget card
items.description: A dashboard row of three SvCard widgets: Revenue with SvStat and SvSparkline, Signups showing a compact SvEmptyState, and Support tickets asking to connect a source. Connect help desk fills that card with data. Stacks on phones.

items.title: Stacked form
items.description: A New project form in one column: SvTextInput, SvTextArea with a counter, SvDropDownList owner, SvRadioGroup visibility and an SvDateTimePicker due date. Create shows errors under each field, then a toast, and adds the project to a list.

items.title: Two-column form
items.description: Account settings in Profile, Address and Notifications sections: title and explanation on the left, the form on the right, built from SvTextInput, SvTextArea, SvDropDownList, SvCheckBox and SvRadioGroup. Each section saves on its own and stacks on phones.

items.title: Notification settings
items.description: Events by Email, Push and SMS with an SvSwitchButton per cell and an SvSegmented digest frequency. A sticky save bar counts unsaved changes; Save stores them and Discard restores the saved state.

items.title: Settings with side nav
items.description: Workspace settings with a General, Security, Billing and Team menu that swaps the form on the right, built from SvTextInput, SvDropDownList, SvSwitchButton and SvSegmented. Team invites members into the list. On phones the menu becomes an SvDropDownList.

items.title: Danger zone
items.description: Destructive project actions in a --sg-danger bordered panel: transfer ownership with an SvDropDownList and SvCheckBox acknowledgement, archive through SvPopconfirm, and delete through an SvModal that enables Delete only once the project name is typed exactly.

items.title: Page heading with breadcrumbs
items.description: Release page heading with an SvBreadcrumb trail above the title, a status SvBadge, and Edit notes / Publish release SvButtons. On phones the trail becomes one Back link.

items.title: Page heading with tabs
items.description: Project heading with Invite and Run sync SvButtons over an SvTabs strip (Overview, Activity, Settings) with live counts. Run sync logs an entry and jumps to Activity.

items.title: Page heading with meta
items.description: Job posting heading with a status SvBadge, icon meta items (location, salary, closing date, manager) and a Status SvMenu. Picking Open, Paused or Closed updates the badge.

items.title: Page heading with stats
items.description: Revenue heading with an SvSegmented 7d/30d/90d switch and four SvStat values with deltas. Changing the range swaps every number; refund rate uses invert.

items.title: Setup wizard
items.description: A four-step workspace setup with SvStepper: name and a live URL slug, teammate emails in SvTagsInput, plan radio cards, then a review. Next checks each step, and Create workspace runs a toast.promise.

items.title: Progress checklist
items.description: A getting-started card with an SvProgress bar and an x of y done count. Each task is an SvCollapsible with a button that completes it; done tasks are struck through, and at 5 of 5 the card turns into a dismissable all-done state.

items.title: Analytics dashboard
items.description: A full overview page: a range SvSegmented + actions header, a KPI grid (SvStat + SvSparkline), a revenue bar panel, a recent-activity SvTimeline and a top-products list with SvProgress bars. No grid dependency.

items.title: App shell
items.description: A complete application layout: a SvNavPane sidebar with sections + badges, a top bar with SvBreadcrumb, search and an account SvMenu, and a routed content area. Nav swaps the page; the toggle collapses the rail to an icon rail.

items.title: KPI cards with icons
items.description: Metric tiles with a tinted inline-SVG icon, today's value and the 7-day average. Clicking a card selects it (aria-pressed) and the SvCard panel below shows that metric's last 7 days as one bar and value per day.

items.title: KPI cards with trend
items.description: Four SvStat cards with the change vs the previous period, an up/down arrow colored by whether the move is good, and the previous value. Churn and time to convert use invert. An SvSegmented 7d/30d/90d switch changes every number.

items.title: KPI cards with sparklines
items.description: Live API metrics in SvCard tiles, each with value, 30-second average and peak, and a full-width SvSparkline area chart. The Live SvSwitchButton appends a point every second; turning it off stops the interval.

items.title: Stats with trends
items.description: Weekly report figures, each with an icon, last week's value and a trend chip; metrics where lower is better flip the chip color. Export CSV downloads the raw numbers and confirms with a toast.

items.title: Banded stats
items.description: Status board on a tinted band: a health SvBadge and a bordered grid of six cells with value, label, status dot and change since an hour ago. An SvSwitchButton turns on live polling.

items.title: Sidebar filters
items.description: Product list with a filter sidebar: SvCheckBox category and brand groups with live counts, a range SvSlider for price, an SvRadioGroup minimum rating and Reset. On phones the filters open in an SvDrawer from a Filters button showing the active count.

items.title: Filter toolbar
items.description: One-row toolbar over a report list: SvTextInput search, SvDropDownList filters for type, team and status, an SvDropDownList sort and an SvSegmented list/grid switch. The list re-sorts and refilters live; the row wraps on phones.

items.title: Applied filter chips
items.description: An Add filter SvMenu with field submenus adds removable SvChip filters like Status: Open. A result count, Clear all and a read-only query-string field with Copy link update with the ticket list.

items.title: Collapsible filters
items.description: SvAccordion filter sections (Status checkboxes, Assignee dropdown, an SvDateRangeInput due date, an SvMultiSelect for tags), each header with an SvBadge count, and an SvGrid of tasks beside them that refilters on every change.

items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: Project activity grouped by day into SvTimeline lists, with a marker color and glyph per event type (commit, comment, deploy, status change), actor, detail and relative time. Load more appends older events with a loading state.

items.title: Notification list
items.description: A bell SvButton with an unread count opens the list in an SvPopover (inline below 560 px): All / Unread SvSegmented, click to mark read, Mark all as read, archive with an Undo toast, and an SvEmptyState when nothing is left.

items.title: Comment feed
items.description: A discussion thread with SvAvatar, name, relative time and body, Like and Reply, and one level of nested replies. Reply opens an inline SvTextArea; the bottom composer validates, shows a loading Post button and appends the comment.

items.title: Audit log
items.description: A compact audit log grouped by day with time, SvAvatar actor, SvBadge action, target and IP. Two SvDropDownList filters narrow it by actor and action, and updated rows expand into a before/after diff of each field.

items.title: Prompt suggestions
items.description: An empty assistant chat with four starter prompt cards over a sales pipeline. A card fills the SvTextInput and sends it to aiFilter, aiSummarize or aiFindAnomalies; the reply appears word by word and a Stop SvButton cancels it.

items.title: Ask bar
items.description: An Ask about your data bar over 30 invoices in an SvGrid. aiFilter turns a question into grid filters and a sort; summarize questions run aiSummarize over the rows on screen. SvChip suggestions, an SvAlert error state and Clear.

items.title: AI settings
items.description: Assistant settings with a model SvDropDownList, temperature SvSlider, max length SvNumberInput, a system prompt SvTextArea with counter and SvSwitchButton tools. A preview card shows the request payload live; Save and Reset confirm with a toast.

items.title: Order history
items.description: Past orders in SvGrid with sortable columns, a right-aligned currency total and an SvBadge status cell. An SvSegmented filters by status, and View or a row click opens the order in an SvDrawer with its lines, totals and address.

items.title: Order tracking
items.description: A shipment page: an SvBadge header, a five-stage delivery stepper with timestamps (across on desktop, down on phones), carrier scan events newest first, and an SvCard with the tracking number and a copy button. Refresh pulls the next scan.

items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: Slim bar above a mock app header with an SvBadge, one line of news, a changelog link and dismiss. Dismissing fires an SvToaster toast with Undo, and an SvButton brings the bar back.

items.title: Inline info banners
items.description: SvAlert in danger, warning, success and info tones inside a settings page, all dismissable. Retry now and Rotate key show a loading state and then clear their banner; Show hidden banners restores them.

items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: Consent bar with Accept all, Reject non-essential and Customize. Customize opens an SvModal with an SvSwitchButton per category (Necessary locked on). The saved choice becomes a one-line summary with Change settings.

items.title: Billing warning banner
items.description: Failed-payment banner with an SvBadge counting days left. Update payment method opens an SvModal card form: SvTextInput plus SvMaskedInput for card number (Luhn check), expiry and CVC. Saving resolves the banner to success.

items.title: Simple navbar
items.description: Brand, four links with aria-current and a Start free trial SvButton over a mock page whose heading follows the current link. Below 768 px a menu button opens an in-flow panel that Escape or a link click closes.

items.title: Navbar with search
items.description: Storefront header with an SvTextInput search that toasts the query, an account SvMenu and a cart button with an SvBadge count that Add to cart raises. On phones the search moves under the bar.

items.title: Navbar with dropdown menus
items.description: Products opens a two-column mega menu of icon, title and description links; Resources opens an SvMenu. Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens, arrow keys move between links, and Escape closes and returns focus.

items.title: Sitemap footer
items.description: Brand and a one-line summary beside four link columns built from one data array, with an SvBadge on a new link and a Back to top SvButton. The columns go 4, 2, then 1 as the screen narrows.

items.title: Simple footer
items.description: One row with the copyright on the left and Privacy, Terms and Status on the right, with an Operational SvBadge on Status. The row stacks on phones.

items.title: Split checkout
items.description: One-page checkout with SvTextInput, SvCountryInput, a delivery SvRadioGroup and SvMaskedInput card fields beside a sticky order summary. Pay checks every field (Luhn check, expiry not in the past), then shows SvButton loading and a toast.

items.title: Stepped checkout
items.description: An SvStepper with Shipping, Payment and Review: SvPhoneInput, SvCountryInput, SvRadioGroup and SvMaskedInput validated per step. Review has Edit links that jump back and return to Review; Place order shows a loading state.

items.title: Payment methods
items.description: Radio cards for Card, Wallet pay, Bank transfer and Invoice with arrow-key navigation; the chosen method's form appears below (SvMaskedInput card, SvPhoneInput, IBAN with a mod-97 check, or VAT number plus SvCountryInput). Continue validates only that method.

items.title: Order confirmation
items.description: Thank-you page with an inline-SVG check mark, a copyable order number, a delivery window counted in business days, next steps, the paid summary with an SvBadge status, and Track order / Continue shopping SvButtons.

items.title: Cart page
items.description: Cart page with SvNumberInput quantities, Remove with an Undo toast and Save for later moving items to a saved list. The summary column has subtotal, estimated shipping, an SvTextInput promo code (WELCOME15 takes 15% off) and Checkout.

items.title: Cart slide-over
items.description: Product grid whose Add to cart SvButtons open an SvDrawer cart with SvNumberInput quantities, Remove, subtotal, Checkout and Continue shopping; the header Cart button shows the item count.

items.title: Rating summary
items.description: The average rating with a read-only half-star SvRating, the review count, 5-to-1 star bars and an SvProgress for would recommend. Click a star row to filter the recent reviews to that rating; Clear filter resets it.

items.title: Review list
items.description: Reviews with SvAvatar, a Verified purchase SvBadge, a read-only SvRating, date, title and a body that clamps to three lines with Read more. Mark a review Helpful once, sort with an SvDropDownList and load the next page.

items.title: Write a review
items.description: A required SvRating, a title, a body with a 30-character minimum and counter, up to three photos in SvFileUpload and a yes/no SvSegmented. Submit validates, shows a loading state, then a thank-you view with the posted review.

items.title: Centered contact form
items.description: A heading over a contact form with SvTextInput name and email, an SvDropDownList topic, an SvTextArea with a counter and a required SvCheckBox. Send validates, shows the loading state, then a sent confirmation.

items.title: Contact cards
items.description: Sales, Support, Press and Partnerships cards with an icon, an email link and an SvButton. Book a demo opens an SvModal form that validates and marks the Sales card with an SvBadge.

items.title: Contact with support hours
items.description: A support ticket form with an SvSegmented priority beside a weekly hours table, an Open now / Opens at badge from the viewer's clock, and response times per channel that change with the priority.

items.title: Centered hero
items.description: Headline, subline, a primary and an outline SvButton and a note, centered over an admin-app product shot drawn in CSS that fades into the page. Copy and CTAs come from the core's options.

items.title: Hero with email sign-up
items.description: Hero whose main CTA is an inline SvTextInput work email plus a Start free trial SvButton. It validates the address, shows loading, puts a server refusal under the field and switches to a check-your-inbox state.

items.title: Features with icons
items.description: A heading, a one-line intro and six features, each an inline-SVG icon with a title and two lines of text, three across, then two, then one. An SvBadge tags the newest feature and the SvButton trial CTA shows its loading state.

items.title: Features with screenshot
items.description: A feature list that works as a tablist (arrow keys, Home, End) beside an inline-SVG product screenshot that redraws for the selected feature: dashboard, SQL editor, alert chart or share dialog.

items.title: Centered call to action
items.description: A heading, one line and two SvButtons centered on an accent band. Start free trial shows its loading state, confirms in an SvToaster toast and leaves a status line; Talk to sales goes through the same tracked action.

items.title: Justified call to action
items.description: A heading and one line on the left, Book a demo and Get started SvButtons on the right of one bordered row. Get started shows loading, confirms in a toast and replaces the buttons with a confirmation. Stacks on phones.

items.title: Pricing
items.description: A three-tier plan grid with a monthly/annual SvSegmented toggle (annual applies the discount live), a highlighted "most popular" card, per-plan feature SvLists with check marks, and a CTA SvButton on each.

items.title: Pricing with highlighted plan
items.description: Four per-seat plans in SvCards with the recommended one outlined and badged. A Seats SvNumberInput reprices every card live, with volume discounts at 25 and 100 seats, monthly totals, and seat caps that switch a plan off.

items.title: Pricing comparison table
items.description: A feature-by-plan table with grouped sections, check marks and limits, and a sticky header row holding each plan's price and SvButton. On phones an SvSegmented picks which plan column is shown.

items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: A heading and a search SvTextInput beside an accordion of questions. Typing filters the list live, highlights each hit with SvMark and opens matching answers; with no matches it offers Clear search and Contact support.

items.title: Centered FAQ accordion
items.description: A centered heading over an SvSegmented Billing / Account / Data switch that swaps the questions in an SvAccordion. Expand all and Collapse all SvButtons open or close every answer in the topic.

items.title: Feature bento
items.description: A feature section as a bento grid: one large tile with a mini results table and four smaller SVG tiles, each with a Read the guide link. Tile spans come from the data; an SvBadge marks the new feature and an SvButton starts the trial.

items.title: Testimonial cards
items.description: Six customer quote cards in a masonry-style column layout, each with a company wordmark, optional SvRating, the quote and an SvAvatar with name and role. Long quotes open with Read more, and the header shows the average rating.

items.title: Testimonial carousel
items.description: One large customer quote at a time in an SvCarousel with arrows, dots, swipe and autoplay that pauses on hover or focus and stays off under reduced motion. A row of company wordmarks jumps to that company's quote.

items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: A heading and a social proof line over twelve made-up customer wordmarks in a ruled grid. Linked logos go from muted to full contrast on hover or focus, and an SvButton opens all customer stories.

items.title: Team grid
items.description: Team member cards with SvAvatar, name, role, bio and labelled email and profile links. An SvSegmented filter narrows the grid by department, and the We're hiring card lists that department's open roles.

items.title: Product card
items.description: Four product cards with color swatches that recolor the art, a read-only SvRating with review count, sale prices with an SvBadge, a wishlist heart (aria-pressed) and Add to cart with loading and a toast. 4, 2 or 1 columns.

items.title: Horizontal product card
items.description: List-view product cards with drawn art, a description and stock status, an SvNumberInput quantity capped at the units left and Add to cart with loading and a toast. Out of stock disables both. Stacks on phones.

items.title: Product list with toolbar
items.description: Twelve store products under a toolbar with the result count, an SvDropDownList sort and an SvSegmented grid/list switch. Load more shows the next eight, and Add to cart fires a toast.

items.title: Featured product list
items.description: A large featured product tile with an SvBadge, price, a short pitch and a Shop now SvButton beside a 2x2 grid of smaller products, each with an Add button that loads and a save toggle.

items.title: Product overview
items.description: Product page with a keyboard-selectable thumbnail gallery, SvRating, color swatches, an SvSegmented size picker that disables sold-out sizes, quantity, Add to cart that asks for a size first, and an SvAccordion with Details, Shipping and Returns.

items.title: Blog post cards
items.description: A blog index grid of six post cards with SVG cover art, a category SvBadge, a 3-line excerpt, an SvAvatar byline, date and reading time. Category chips filter the grid; an empty category shows an SvEmptyState with Show all posts.

items.title: Featured article
items.description: A lead article with a large SVG cover, a category SvBadge, the excerpt and an SvAvatar byline with date and reading time, beside the four most recent posts and a View all posts link. Stacks on phones.
